disclaimer: Simplified estimate using progressive salaries tax rates. Hong Kong taxes the lower of progressive rates or the standard rate (15%). Basic allowance of HK$132,000 is applied as standard deduction. MPF contributions, other allowances, and the standard-rate comparison are not included.

regimes.label: Progressive Salaries Tax (2024-25)
regimes.notes: Basic allowance of HK$132,000 applied as standard deduction. In practice, taxpayers pay the lower of progressive rates or the 15% standard rate on net income.
